# DocuExtract

> DocuExtract is a free, open-source web app that converts PDF invoices to Excel (.xlsx), CSV and JSON in the user's browser. The application code does not upload invoice files to an application backend.

## Key facts
- Free, MIT licensed, with no account, backend, database, analytics or telemetry in the application.
- Processes text-based PDFs locally; up to 50 PDFs per batch, with 25 MB and 100-page limits per PDF.
- Can split multiple invoices in one PDF when invoice boundaries are detected.
- Supports India, United States, United Kingdom and Germany locale parsing.
- Local OCR languages: English, German and Hindi. German and Hindi extraction accuracy is experimental and OCR output requires review.
- Consent-based seller templates store matching and reading rules locally; they do not replace review.
- Exports XLSX, invoice CSV, line-items CSV and JSON.
- Extraction is heuristic. Review values before accounting or tax use.
